kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.definition: Trailing-twelve-month revenue growth versus the prior year.

kpis.label: Gross margin
kpis.definition: Gross profit as a share of revenue.

kpis.label: Inventory days
kpis.definition: Days of inventory based on average inventory and cost of goods sold.

kpis.label: Operating margin
kpis.definition: Operating income as a share of revenue.

kpis.label: Dividend yield
kpis.definition: Indicated dividend divided by the latest close.

kpis.label: Revenue mix disclosure
kpis.definition: 1 disclosed segment. A single consolidated line is not treated as a segment split.
